title: OL-20261112-93: Server-side only: the bootstrap credential ladder still counts a signed-in CLI on the host it runs on
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** next executor pass after the server-side-only change merges
**Done check:** grep:doctrine/server-side.json::signed-in-cli
**Status:** closed

Residual of the server-side-only change (Session: session_0156nqDuUz7hvNg4YU9MVeAS). seed/bootstrap/bootstrap.py and foundation/ladder.py count a signed-in gh CLI found on the host the bootstrap runs on as the org-admin credential (BG-13; seed/tests/test_seed.py GhAdminOrgTests), and demos/public/cases.json narrates that route as one that worked on a person's computer. In a cloud session or an Actions job that host is server-side; on a person's computer it is not. Change: make the ladder accept that sign-in only when the host is server-side (CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE or GITHUB_ACTIONS set), update the test and the case study, add a banned pattern with id signed-in-cli to doctrine/server-side.json for the old wording, and drop demos/public/cases.json from the exclude list. Closing probe: the pattern id is in doctrine/server-side.json and python3 -m foundation serverside --check passes.

**Evidence:** seed/bootstrap/bootstrap.py _gh_admin_org returns False off a server-side host; banned pattern signed-in-cli in doctrine/server-side.json; seed/tests/test_seed.py GhAdminOrgTests.
